activities.activity_description: Analyze the existing json-to-tuple module in Spring XD, adapt it to Spring Cloud Stream's processor model, implement the code, and write unit tests.
Analyze the existing object-to-json module in Spring XD, adapt it to Spring Cloud Stream's processor model, implement the code, and write unit tests.

Analyze the existing script module in Spring XD, adapt it to Spring Cloud Stream's processor model, implement the code, and write unit tests. This module may require additional logic for script execution.
Analyze the existing shell module in Spring XD, adapt it to Spring Cloud Stream's processor model, implement the code, and write unit tests.
Analyze the existing splitter module in Spring XD, adapt it to Spring Cloud Stream's processor model, implement the code, and write unit tests.
Explore and implement options to remove composed job functionality to reduce resource usage and memory footprint.
Design and implement a mechanism to store composed job definitions in Zookeeper for job recovery from failure scenarios.
Design and implement a BinderFactory abstraction to support multiple binder types in the future, including interfaces and factory methods.
Perform integration testing across all ported modules and new features to ensure compatibility and functionality.
Write documentation for all ported modules, the BinderFactory abstraction, and changes to composed job handling.
Set up the project structure, configure dependencies, and ensure build scripts are compatible with the target repository.
